_meta.name: document-intake-golden-set
_meta.schema: Each line after _meta is one multi-turn case. turns[].expect.state is a DELTA of facts that must hold after that turn; runner accumulates it. null means null/empty. expect.next is the next field, confirm, or null when done. expect.rejected lists fields rejected that turn. expect.skip lists skipped fields. reply_forbidden/reply_required validate response text. mock is an optional oracle output. final.state is the golden end state.
